subcategory_text: Inventories of services provided by suppliers are maintained
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: AC-20, SA-09, SR-02
implementation_examples: Inventory all external services used by the organization, including third-party infrastructure-as-a-service (IaaS), platform-as-a-service (PaaS), and software-as-a-service (SaaS) offerings; APIs; and other externally hosted application services
Update the inventory when a new external service is going to be utilized to ensure adequate cybersecurity risk management monitoring of the organization's use of that service
assessment_objectives: Determine whether inventories of services provided by suppliers are maintained.

Determine whether mechanisms ensure that inventory all external services used by the organization, including third-party infrastructure-as-a-service (IaaS), platform-as-a-service (PaaS), and software-as-a-service (SaaS) offerings; APIs; and other externally hosted application services.

Determine whether activities are conducted to update the inventory when a new external service is going to be utilized to ensure adequate cybersecurity risk management monitoring of the organization's use of that service.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
